title: diabelia spathulata
intro: Diabelia spathulata, commonly known as "Golden Root", is a plant species that belongs to the Caprifoliaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of Diabelia spathulata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, hepatoprotective, and anti-hyperglycemic effects. The plant's therapeutic actions make it a potential candidate for the treatment of various diseases, including diabetes, inflammation, and infections.
